steps.name: Launch wizard
steps.expected: Welcome page renders with app logo, title, description, and Next button

steps.name: Verify content
steps.expected: Welcome message explains the setup process and what will be configured

steps.name: Click Next
steps.action: Click Next button on welcome page
steps.expected: Navigates to protocol selection page

steps.name: Verify transition
steps.expected: Step indicator shows step 2 active, step 1 completed

steps.name: Verify page loads
steps.expected: Page shows all supported protocols: SMB, FTP, NFS, WebDAV, Local

steps.name: Verify descriptions
steps.expected: Each protocol has a name, icon, and brief description of use case

steps.name: Click SMB option
steps.expected: SMB is selected with visual highlight

steps.name: Click Next
steps.expected: Navigates to SMB configuration page

steps.name: Click Local option
steps.action: Click on Local filesystem protocol card
steps.expected: Local is selected with visual highlight

steps.name: Click Next
steps.expected: Navigates to local path configuration page

steps.name: Verify page loads
steps.expected: Network scan page renders with Scan button and explanation text

steps.name: Verify UI elements
steps.expected: Scan button, results area (empty initially), and Skip option visible

steps.name: Click Scan
steps.expected: Scanning indicator/animation starts

steps.name: Verify progress
steps.expected: Progress indicator shows scanning is in progress, IP range being scanned

steps.name: Wait for scan completion
steps.expected: Scan finishes and results are displayed

steps.name: Check results
steps.expected: Each result shows hostname/IP, share name, and protocol type

steps.name: Select a result
steps.expected: Share details pre-fill into configuration fields on next step

steps.name: Verify page loads
steps.expected: SMB config form renders with host, share, username, password, domain fields

steps.name: Verify field labels
steps.expected: All fields have labels and helpful placeholder text

steps.name: Enter host
steps.expected: Field accepts hostname or IP address

steps.name: Validate input
steps.expected: Valid hostname format accepted, invalid format shows error

steps.name: Enter share name
steps.expected: Field accepts share name

steps.name: Enter credentials
steps.action: Type username and password for SMB share
steps.expected: Username field accepts input, password field masks input

steps.name: Click Test Connection
steps.action: Click Test Connection button after filling SMB fields
steps.expected: Connection test initiates with loading indicator

steps.name: Success case
steps.action: If credentials and host are valid
steps.expected: Green success message: 'Connection successful' with share details

steps.name: Failure case
steps.expected: Red error message with specific failure reason (timeout, auth failed, share not found)

steps.name: Select FTP protocol
steps.action: Go back and select FTP protocol, then proceed
steps.expected: FTP config form renders with host, port, username, password, passive mode toggle

steps.name: Verify defaults
steps.expected: Port defaults to 21, passive mode enabled by default

steps.name: Enter FTP host
steps.action: Type FTP server hostname or IP
steps.expected: Field accepts input

steps.name: Enter port
steps.expected: Port field accepts numeric input only

steps.name: Enter credentials
steps.expected: Fields accept input, password is masked

steps.name: Click Test Connection
steps.expected: FTP connection test runs

steps.name: Verify result
steps.expected: Success or failure message with specific details

steps.name: Select NFS protocol
steps.action: Go back and select NFS protocol, then proceed
steps.expected: NFS config form renders with host, export path, and NFS version fields

steps.name: Verify NFS-specific fields
steps.expected: Export path field, NFS version selector (v3/v4), mount options visible

steps.name: Enter NFS host
steps.action: Type NFS server hostname or IP
steps.expected: Field accepts input

steps.name: Enter export path
steps.expected: Field accepts Unix-style path

steps.name: Click Test Connection
steps.action: Click Test Connection button with NFS settings
steps.expected: NFS mount test executes

steps.name: Verify result
steps.expected: Success shows available exports, failure shows specific NFS error

steps.name: Select WebDAV protocol
steps.action: Go back and select WebDAV protocol, then proceed
steps.expected: WebDAV config form renders with URL, username, password fields

steps.name: Verify URL field
steps.expected: Placeholder shows example: 'https://server.com/webdav/media'

steps.name: Enter WebDAV URL
steps.action: Type full WebDAV URL including path
steps.expected: Field accepts full URL with protocol prefix

steps.name: Validate URL format
steps.expected: Invalid URL format shows validation error

steps.name: Enter credentials
steps.expected: Fields accept input

steps.name: Click Test Connection
steps.action: Click Test Connection button with WebDAV settings
steps.expected: WebDAV PROPFIND request executed

steps.name: Verify result
steps.expected: Success shows server response, failure shows HTTP error code and message

steps.name: Select Local protocol
steps.expected: Local config page renders with path input field and Browse button

steps.name: Verify layout
steps.expected: Path input, Browse button, and path validation indicator visible

steps.name: Click Browse
steps.expected: Native OS directory picker dialog opens via Tauri

steps.name: Select directory
steps.action: Navigate to and select a media directory
steps.expected: Selected path appears in the path input field

steps.name: Verify path display
steps.expected: Full absolute path displayed in the field

steps.name: Enter valid path
steps.action: Enter path to existing directory with media files
steps.expected: Green validation indicator: directory exists and is readable

steps.name: Enter invalid path
steps.expected: Red validation error: 'Directory does not exist'

steps.name: Enter file path
steps.action: Enter path to a file instead of directory
steps.expected: Validation error: 'Path must be a directory'

steps.name: Navigate to config management
steps.expected: Page shows current configuration summary and Save/Load options

steps.name: Verify config display
steps.expected: Selected protocol, connection details (password masked), and path shown

steps.name: Click Save Configuration
steps.expected: File save dialog opens via Tauri

steps.name: Save file
steps.expected: Configuration saved as JSON file, success notification shown

steps.name: Verify file
steps.expected: JSON file contains all configuration values (passwords encrypted or excluded)

steps.name: Click Load Configuration
steps.expected: File open dialog opens

steps.name: Select config file
steps.action: Select a previously saved configuration JSON file
steps.expected: Configuration values loaded and populated into form fields

steps.name: Verify loaded values
steps.expected: Protocol, host, path, and other settings match the saved file

steps.name: Navigate to summary
steps.action: Complete all configuration steps and reach summary page
steps.expected: Summary page renders with complete configuration review

steps.name: Verify all sections
steps.expected: Protocol, connection details, path, and all settings displayed in readable format

steps.name: Review each field
steps.action: Read through all configuration fields on summary page
steps.expected: All entered values are correctly displayed

steps.name: Check edit links
steps.action: Look for edit/change links next to each section
steps.expected: Each section has an Edit link that navigates back to that step

steps.name: Click edit
steps.expected: Navigates back to that configuration step with values preserved

steps.name: Click Complete/Finish
steps.action: Click Complete Setup / Finish button on summary page
steps.expected: Configuration is applied and saved

steps.name: Verify completion
steps.expected: Success screen or dialog: 'Setup complete! You can now start using Catalogizer.'

steps.name: Verify API configuration
steps.action: Check that storage root was created via API
steps.expected: New storage root appears in catalog-api configuration

steps.name: Navigate to step 3
steps.action: Proceed through welcome, protocol, to step 3
steps.expected: On step 3 of wizard

steps.name: Click Back
steps.expected: Navigates to step 2, all previously entered data preserved

steps.name: Click Back again
steps.expected: Navigates to step 1 (welcome)

steps.name: Start at welcome
steps.expected: On step 1

steps.name: Click Next
steps.expected: Navigates to step 2 (protocol selection)

steps.name: Select and continue
steps.action: Select a protocol and click Next
steps.expected: Navigates to step 3 (protocol-specific configuration)

steps.name: Verify linear flow
steps.action: Continue clicking Next through all steps
steps.expected: Each step advances in correct order

steps.name: Reach optional step
steps.expected: Network scan page visible

steps.name: Click Skip
steps.expected: Advances to next step without performing network scan

steps.name: Verify skipped
steps.action: Check that configuration continues without scan data
steps.expected: Manual configuration fields are empty (not pre-filled from scan)

steps.name: Check progress at step 1
steps.action: Look at step/progress indicator on welcome page
steps.expected: Step 1 highlighted as active, remaining steps shown as upcoming

steps.name: Advance to step 3
steps.expected: Steps 1-2 shown as completed (checkmarks), step 3 shown as active

steps.name: Navigate back to step 2
steps.expected: Step 2 becomes active again, step 1 still shows completed

steps.name: Leave required fields empty
steps.action: Try to click Next without filling required fields
steps.expected: Validation errors shown on empty required fields, Next button disabled or prevented

steps.name: Enter invalid host
steps.action: Type 'not a valid host!!!' in host field
steps.expected: Validation error: invalid hostname format

steps.name: Enter invalid port
steps.expected: Validation error: port must be between 1 and 65535

steps.name: Configure unreachable host
steps.action: Enter a valid format but unreachable host (10.255.255.1) and click Test Connection
steps.expected: Loading indicator shows for test

steps.name: Wait for timeout
steps.action: Wait for connection test to time out
steps.expected: Error message: 'Connection timed out' within reasonable time (10-30 seconds)

steps.name: Verify recovery
steps.expected: New test can be initiated, previous error cleared

steps.name: Partially complete wizard
steps.expected: Wizard is partially completed

steps.name: Click Cancel/Close
steps.action: Click Cancel button or close the wizard window
steps.expected: Confirmation dialog: 'Are you sure? Setup is not complete.'

steps.name: Confirm cancel
steps.expected: Wizard closes, no configuration is saved

steps.name: Decline cancel
steps.action: Reopen wizard, partially fill, cancel, then click No
steps.expected: Wizard remains open on current step with data preserved

steps.name: Start wizard
steps.expected: Welcome page renders with setup instructions and Next button

challenges.name: User Flow SMB: Select SMB Protocol

steps.name: Select SMB
steps.action: Click Next on welcome, select SMB/CIFS protocol card
steps.expected: SMB highlighted as selected, Next button enabled

steps.name: Fill SMB fields
steps.action: Enter host, share name, username, password, click Next
steps.expected: All fields validated, navigates to test connection step

steps.name: Test SMB connection
steps.expected: Connection test runs, shows success or failure with specific message

steps.name: Scan for devices
steps.action: Click Scan Network to discover SMB shares
steps.expected: Network scan runs with progress indicator, discovered shares listed

challenges.name: User Flow SMB: Save and Complete

steps.name: Save and finish
steps.expected: Configuration saved, success message shown, storage root created via API

steps.name: Start wizard
steps.expected: Welcome page renders, Next button available

challenges.name: User Flow Local: Select Local Protocol

steps.name: Select Local
steps.action: Click Next on welcome, select Local filesystem card
steps.expected: Local filesystem highlighted, Next button enabled

steps.name: Browse for directory
steps.action: Click Browse button, select a media directory from native file picker
steps.expected: Selected path appears in input field, validation indicator shows green

steps.name: Validate directory
steps.action: Verify the selected path shows as valid directory
steps.expected: Green checkmark, directory exists and is readable, Next button enabled

challenges.name: User Flow Local: Save and Complete

steps.name: Complete setup
steps.action: Navigate through summary, click Complete Setup
steps.expected: Local storage root created, success confirmation displayed

steps.name: Navigate forward 3
steps.action: Click Next through welcome, protocol, and configuration steps
steps.expected: Reaches step 3 with progress indicator showing 3 completed

steps.name: Navigate back 2
steps.expected: Returns to protocol selection (step 2 content), all previously entered data preserved

steps.name: Fill data and go back
steps.action: Enter SMB host/share on config page, go back to protocol selection, come forward again
steps.expected: SMB configuration fields retain previously entered values

steps.name: Go back then forward
steps.action: From step 3, go back to step 1, then forward through all steps to summary
steps.expected: All previously entered data is preserved through the entire back-forward cycle

steps.name: Enter invalid host
steps.action: Type 'not a valid host!!!' in host field and attempt to proceed
steps.expected: Validation error displayed: invalid hostname format, Next button disabled

steps.name: Enter invalid port
steps.expected: Validation error: port must be between 1 and 65535

steps.name: Enter invalid URL
steps.expected: Validation error: invalid URL format, must start with http:// or https://

steps.name: Leave fields empty
steps.action: Attempt to click Next with all required fields empty on SMB config page
steps.expected: Validation errors appear on each required field (host, share), Next button disabled or prevented

steps.name: Scan with no results
steps.action: Run network scan on a subnet with no SMB/NFS devices
steps.expected: Scan completes, message 'No devices found' displayed, option to retry or configure manually

steps.name: Scan with timeout
steps.action: Run network scan on a large subnet that takes too long
steps.expected: Scan times out after reasonable duration (30s), partial results shown if any, timeout message displayed

steps.name: Scan with partial discovery
steps.action: Run scan where some devices respond and some do not
steps.expected: Responding devices listed in results, non-responding ignored, scan completes successfully

steps.name: Save config to file
steps.action: Complete wizard configuration, click Save Configuration
steps.expected: Configuration exported as JSON file via native file save dialog

steps.name: Load config from file
steps.action: Click Load Configuration, select previously saved JSON file
steps.expected: All form fields populated from loaded configuration file, protocol and settings restored

steps.name: Overwrite config
steps.action: Save configuration to same filename as existing config
steps.expected: Overwrite confirmation dialog appears, file overwritten on confirm, previous content replaced

steps.name: Configure SMB then switch to NFS
steps.action: Complete SMB configuration, go back to protocol selection, select NFS, configure NFS
steps.expected: NFS configuration page loads with fresh fields, SMB config data not leaked into NFS fields

steps.name: Switch protocols
steps.action: Select FTP, enter some config, go back, select WebDAV
steps.expected: WebDAV configuration page shows clean fields, FTP-specific fields (port, passive mode) not shown
